risk_description: Model complexity may limit ability to produce specific and accurate principal reasons for adverse action
existing_controls: Reason code methodology validated by Model Risk; sample reviewed quarterly by Compliance
notes: CFPB Circular 2023-03 considered in method selection

risk_description: Geographic and industry features may proxy for protected class
existing_controls: Annual fairness testing; less discriminatory alternative search documented at build

risk_description: Deprioritization of true positives could reduce suspicious activity detection effectiveness
existing_controls: No alert suppressed; all alerts reviewed; threshold rationale under documentation
notes: Condition open: document and validate threshold rationale

risk_description: Assistant may state incorrect fee rate or term to a customer creating UDAAP exposure
existing_controls: Retrieval grounding with citation; fixed evaluation set with 98 percent accuracy threshold; 5 percent output sampling; escalation to live agent
notes: Evaluation repeated on every vendor model version change

risk_description: Provider may update the foundation model without notice changing behavior in production
existing_controls: Contractual notice clause added at 2026 renewal; version pinning available; re-evaluation on change
notes: Notice clause is the control that makes the reassessment trigger operable

risk_description: Customer supplied text could manipulate assistant behavior or extract system content
existing_controls: Input and output filtering; no tool or action authority; adversarial testing before launch and on version change

risk_description: Agents may accept suggestions without independent judgment under handle time pressure
existing_controls: Override rate monitored monthly with 25 percent threshold; agents not measured on suggestion acceptance; quarterly calibration
notes: Condition open: add suggestion confidence display to agent interface

risk_description: Errors propagate into AML monitoring without independent detection at the consuming model
existing_controls: Dependency mapped in both directions; exception queue for steward review; error rate reported to AML model owner
notes: Category C risk pattern; most likely place for undocumented AI risk inside a validated model

risk_description: Retrieval could surface content the requesting user is not entitled to see
existing_controls: Entitlement aware retrieval enforced at index level; tested semiannually with segregated accounts
notes: Most common serious finding in early enterprise retrieval deployments

risk_description: Employees may enter customer or confidential data into the tool
existing_controls: DLP extended to this destination; acceptable use policy attestation; tenant isolation and zero retention configured
notes: Pattern P-01 conditions limit approved data classification to internal

risk_description: Vendor screening feature ranks applicants with no fairness testing performed by bank or vendor
existing_controls: Feature disabled; recruiters reviewed all candidates during the period it was active; look back underway
notes: Enabled by vendor default in 2025 and not registered; found through the annual vendor AI questionnaire

risk_description: An automatic Tier 1 system operated in production for 18 months without registration
existing_controls: Vendor AI questionnaire now annual; default off negotiated at renewal; discovery sweep extended to all HR systems
notes: Root cause: intake did not reach vendor enabled features; acceptable use policy section 6 updated in response

risk_description: Four of ten registered systems depend on a single foundation model provider
existing_controls: Dependency map maintained; concentration reported semiannually; alternative provider identified for AI-0003
notes: Concentration exists across different contracted vendors sharing one model provider

risk_description: Discovery continues to find systems that did not come through intake
existing_controls: Quarterly discovery across procurement CASB expense and vendor attestation; non punitive registration path
notes: Coverage estimated at 82 percent against discovery; target above 90 percent
